summary: The reconstruction coverage obligation is introduced: the before source has no reconstruction branch, while the after source adds one that the old harness cannot reach.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established that this target should cover retained number-state reconstruction.

before.requirement: Execute retained number-state reconstruction in json_tokener_parse_ex.
before.reason: The complete before function has no reconstruction branch; its number state begins with fresh local exponent state.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows how the earlier parser saved an incomplete number and exited.

after.requirement: Resume a partial number on the same tokener to execute the added reconstruction of saved exponent state.
after.reason: The added branch requires saved number text from an earlier call. The unchanged harness makes one call on a fresh tokener.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Saves an incomplete number when a chunk ends.

claims.comparison_reason: The old harness also made one call, but the exact reconstruction capability did not exist before. The added nonempty-buffer guard is the unsatisfied condition for this frozen obligation.
